title: Jak funguje digitální svět
subtitle: Základy informatiky a umělé inteligence pro 2. stupeň ZŠ: 24 jader v 6 kapitolách
subject: computing and artificial intelligence for lower-secondary school (algorithms, programs, data, computers and networks, AI, online safety)
author: AI dětem
audience: pupils aged 11-15 (Czech 2. stupeň ZŠ) and their teachers

source.description: Kniha stojí na upravené Mapě informatických konceptů Glitch: z 202 uzlů 24 jader v 6 kapitolách, výlety do hloubky a šest světů (hry, weby, aplikace, roboti, tvorba s AI, sociální sítě), ve kterých se jádra vyprávějí znovu. Mapa vychází z revidovaného RVP Informatika (2024) a rámců CSTA K-12, UNESCO AI Competency Framework, AI4K12 a DigComp 2.2.

lensWorlds.generic: examples from school, phones, games and apps that pupils aged 11-15 know
lensWorlds.hry: the world of games: making a game in Scratch or a game engine, game loops, collisions, scores, sprites, online play and gaming accounts
lensWorlds.weby: the world of websites: a school club web page, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, what happens after Enter, hosting and domains, the padlock in the address bar, cookies and trackers
lensWorlds.aplikace: the world of mobile apps: designing a class app on paper, App Inventor and no-code tools, app state and buttons, apps built on a spreadsheet, permissions, frontend and backend, apps written with AI
lensWorlds.roboti: the world of robots and the BBC micro:bit: sensors and actuators, MakeCode blocks, line-following cars, LED display, radio and CreateAI gesture models
lensWorlds.tvorba: the world of creating with AI: generated images, video and music, prompts, why video files are big, where a prompt is processed, bias in training data, reach on video platforms, authorship and labelling AI content
lensWorlds.socialni: the world of social media and video: the infinite feed, recommendations and filter bubbles, privacy circles, video statistics, end-to-end encrypted chats, deepfakes, stolen accounts, fake giveaways and what a photo reveals
